text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket gave it her all, but lost 
to Narita Taishin, who delivered a run 
filled with fierce spirit.

Overwhelmed by Narita Taishin, Winning 
Ticket mutters that she has to try even 
harder next time.

With that goal in mind, the sights were 
set on the grand finale of the first half 
of the Twinkle Series: the Takarazuka 
Kinen.
